subject: humanities
passage: Kalamkari is a textile art from southern India whose name means roughly "pen work." In its traditional hand-drawn style, artists sketch each design freehand on cotton cloth with a pen cut from bamboo, then fill it in with dyes made from plants and minerals. Because every line is drawn by hand rather than printed by a machine, no two pieces of kalamkari are exactly ______.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: Each design is drawn "freehand," and every line is made "by hand rather than printed by a machine." Hand drawing always varies a little, so the pieces cannot be identical. "Alike" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Hand drawing has nothing to do with a piece's age, and the text never discusses when pieces were made.
explanation.B: Correct. Because each line is drawn by hand, every piece varies slightly, so no two are exactly alike.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The text says nothing about price; hand drawing explains why pieces differ from one another, not what they cost.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text does not discuss how bright the colors are, and hand drawing would not explain a difference in brightness.
